title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - PowerSequenceElement
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/PowerSequenceElement. An element of a power sequence, roughly equivalent to slots in the existing S4ener. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PowerSequenceElement'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
